drafter.private_reasoning: The draft leaves key economic terms unspecified and contains an overly broad non-compete. Propose a workable compensation structure with the salary amount reserved for confirmation, a defined severance formula, and a narrower, law-compliant restriction. Do not disclose confidential client information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is a first-pass markup to make the core economic terms and post-employment restriction more workable. We have left the annual salary figure for agreement and proposed six months of base salary as severance. Please let us know your client’s preferred salary figure and any comments on the narrowed non-compete.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $[●], payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, plus eligibility to participate in the Company’s benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans. The Company may review the Base Salary from time to time, but no review will reduce the Base Salary.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, and the Executive timely signs and does not revoke a customary release of claims, the Company shall pay the Executive severance equal to six months of the Executive’s then-current Base Salary, less applicable withholdings, in substantially equal installments over six months in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices. “Cause” means a material breach of this Agreement that remains uncured for 30 days after written notice, fraud or embezzlement involving the Company, conviction of or plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony, or willful misconduct in the performance of the Executive’s duties.

4. NON-COMPETE. During the 12 months following the Executive’s departure, the Executive shall not, within any geographic area in which the Company conducted material business and for which the Executive had material responsibility during the 12 months before departure, perform services substantially similar to the Executive’s services for the Company for a business that directly competes with the Company’s products or services with which the Executive was materially involved. This restriction applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law and shall be construed narrowly to permit enforcement to the maximum lawful extent.

receiver.message_back: Our client proposes an annual base salary of $500,000 and 12 months of severance following termination without Cause. The non-compete remains too broad in duration and scope; we propose deleting it, or, at minimum, limiting it to six months and to specific competing products and territories for which the Executive had direct responsibility.

drafter.private_reasoning: Accept the proposed salary and severance terms to move the negotiation forward. Narrow the non-compete to six months and to directly competing products and territories for which the Executive had direct responsibility, while retaining the applicable-law limitation.

Please let us know if your client can proceed on this basis.
